dimensions.mission: Risk-sufficient verification supports the elected agent without a cashflow/alpha claim.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Existing useful tests and frozen contracts/evidence remain; suitable TDD stays optional.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One existing policy owner; two primary files; no new framework, registry, schema or mandatory metric.
dimensions.research_truth: Independent oracles, real-path boundaries, truthful UNKNOWN and scoped evidence preserve scientific admissibility.
dimensions.owner_operability: Ordinary bounded autonomy and exact-head owner merge phrase remain unchanged.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: NEUTRAL: instruction patch only; no measured economics gain.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: No runtime changes; ordinary inverse policy patch preserves regression evidence.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: Use existing skill, domain policy, checks and sync; no adoption/install needed.
dimensions.security: CI/security/authority gates, production bindings and live/provider/science budgets retained.
dimensions.red_team: Zero new tests is not zero verification; logs/mocks/self-authored happy paths and lucky rerolls cannot replace risk evidence.

capability_radar.watch: Named missed risk in an ordinary natural low-risk atom; patch that gap without instrumentation.

recovery: Ordinary inverse patch of the two instruction owners, scoped generated sync and unchanged owner gate.
